title: PazaBench: Large-Scale ASR Benchmark for Low-Resource Languages in Africa
abstract: arXiv:2611.31578v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Low-resource languages remain underrepresented in ASR benchmarks, limiting the ability to reliably assess and compare model performance. We present a large-scale benchmark for automatic speech recognition (ASR) on low-resource languages in Africa. The benchmark harmonizes six public corpora into a unified, reproducible evaluation framework and evaluates 52 state-of-the-art ASR models spanning three model architectural paradigms across 39 African languages on diverse datasets. Models are evaluated using standard accuracy and efficiency metrics, word error rate (WER), character error rate (CER), and inverse real-time factor (RTFx). This benchmark introduces architecture-aware comparison that systematically analyzes both individual models and broader model families. translated_title: PazaBench：面向非洲低资源语言的大规模自动语音识别基准测试
translated_abstract: 低资源语言在自动语音识别（ASR）基准测试中的代表性仍然不足，限制了可靠评估和比较模型性能的能力。我们提出了一个针对非洲低资源语言的大规模自动语音识别基准测试。该基准将六个公开语料库整合为统一、可复现的评估框架，并在多样化数据集上对涵盖三种模型架构范式的52个最先进ASR模型在39种非洲语言上进行了评估。模型采用标准的准确性与效率指标进行评估，包括词错误率（WER）、字符错误率（CER）和逆实时因子（RTFx）。该基准引入了架构感知的比较方法，系统性地分析单个模型及更广泛的模型家族。此外，我们量化了不同语言族之间的语言学差异，揭示了这些因素如何影响各种非洲语言的ASR性能。我们还提供了一个……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出PazaBench，首个将六个公开语料库整合为统一可复现评估框架的大规模非洲低资源语言ASR基准，在39种非洲语言上评估了52个最先进模型，并引入架构感知比较与语言学差异量化分析。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PazaBench, a large-scale ASR benchmark that harmonizes six public corpora into a unified, reproducible evaluation framework, evaluating 52 state-of-the-art models across 39 African languages with architecture-aware comparison and quantified linguistic variance analysis.
